manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: A ball tossed upward beside its velocity-time line. At the top the velocity is zero but the slope stays -g.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: The left scene shows the ball on a height ruler with velocity and acceleration arrows. The right graph shows v = u - g t with a marker. Force is mass times gravity.
